mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verifications (email, code, expires_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{code}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT verification_id, email, code, verified, expires_at, created_at FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email} AND code = #{code} AND verified = 0 AND expires_at > NOW() ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verifications SET verified = 1 WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email} AND verified = 1
